package.name: pnp_sensor_monitor
package.description:
Plug-and-Play Sensor Monitor for UGV.
This package monitors a Raspberry Pi (Intelligent Sensor Hub) for available PnP sensors and automatically starts Application containers on the UGV to consume sensor data.
Part of the IAS 2025 Thesis: Industrial Plug-and-Play Sensor Integration using Asset Administration Shell (AAS).
package.author: IAS Thesis Project 2025
